holder-quote: The other [Guardsmen] had seen what was going on. The one called Relc leapt over a table and ran at Ryoka.
effect-quote: He slammed his head into Ryoka’s.

holder-quote: Relc waited a heartbeat, and then head-butted the other Drake.
effect-quote: The younger one wobbled, and then fell over.

holder-quote: Relc had had enough of Tesy’s rhetoric. The thwok of two heads meeting echoed loudly in the alleyway. Tesy went cross-eyed. He shouted through the pain.
effect-quote: The thwok of two heads meeting echoed loudly in the alleyway.
